Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog: Fix the Animations tab sometimes staying empty until a manual Rescan after a full game restart, and add an explicit per-mod Enabled checkbox in the Animation Library (fixing it not being clickable due to overlapping the mod header's own click region).
